The '''Blue Nova''' was a small [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[3DC/Green]]. It offered a wide selection of [[Liquor/Legends|liquors]] and was favored by the station's crew as a relaxation spot.<ref name="HS" />
